These two internal modalities converge on the same direction of contrast, and the WXS trend (lower PBRM1/VHL) is directionally consistent though not FDR-significant. Membership is structurally compatible: all five modalities show positive median silhouettes, patient support is moderate (median 3/5), and the fused probe is non-degenerate with moderate resampling stability. No measured technical factor provides a dominant alternative explanation (all confounder q>0.18, no deterministic flags), and known-label echo is near zero, so the candidate is not merely recapitulating stage or grade. Structural evidence does not positively support a Split (internal probe is near-zero silhouette and not a credible reproducible partition) or a Merge with C0002 (RNA boundary silhouette 0.024 and opposite-direction biology indicate the two sets are distinct). Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

limitations: CNV evidence is non-significant and cannot corroborate the RNA/WXS pattern.
